feeds.title: Whistle Blog » Employee Retention
feeds.description: Whistle is a platform that assists companies in fostering employee loyalty. It achieves this by integrating essential elements such as improved onboarding, employee payments, remote team engagement, and learning experiences. Their blog features articles on employee retention, office culture, employee policies, incentives, budgets, and rewards. Follow their blog to learn more about cultivating employee loyalty for better business outcomes.

feeds.description: Gympass is the only corporate well-being platform that offers access to 50,000+ gyms and studios, 700+ activities, and the best well-being apps. We are the well-being solution for some of the most employee-centric companies worldwide - large and small. Join the club.

feeds.title: The SHRM Blog
feeds.description: SHRM is the world's largest HR organization helping HR and business leaders create highly effective strategies. Their blog features articles and insights from HR professionals and industry experts on a wide range of topics related to human resources, including talent acquisition, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion, leadership, and more.

feeds.title: Employee Retention & Engagement Resources - Work Institute Blog
feeds.description: Work institute employs several strategies and tools to assist with employee retention programs, talent development solutions, employment consulting, and data gathering. Ask questions. Be engaged. Retain employees. Go through their blog and shares articles on the interview process, employee turnover, work ethics, employee retention strategies, feedback forms and more related topics.
